program.name: Power Yoga Ladder
program.subject: Power yoga
program.blurb: Power yoga that builds: each flow adds a pose and goes round again.
program.about: A practice that grows as you go. Sun salutations, then a short standing flow; then the same flow with more poses added, then more again, before core and a rest. Two practices alternate. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
